subject: Re: Red teaming status: pipeline live, mode collapse risk
body:
Team,

Decision ahead of next week's LRB: we propose the red-team gate with distinct-mode coverage as the primary metric, per Fumiko's analysis — raw prompt counts overstate coverage and I would rather set the honest precedent.

Harness call: v1 (corpus management, batch scoring, dashboards) is the launch-gate deliverable; the exposure trend views move to a fast-follow. Chiara, freeze v1 scope Friday.

Staffing: Halima stays at 60% through June to carry the gate through its first three real launches.

If LRB accepts, the gate applies to language launches from Jun 15. Deck to me by May 18 please.

Priya
